summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Kedai Foto Kopi site update. All 11 core requirements verified successfully. Brand update, menu replacement (23 products), smart search, filter updates, WhatsApp/Maps URLs, and mobile responsiveness all working correctly.

design_issues.issue: Hero title contains 'Kopi lokal berkualitas' which uses 'kopi lokal' (local coffee) as descriptive text. While not the old brand name 'KopiLokal', this may warrant review for brand consistency.

passed_tests: Exactly 23 product cards render with correct names and prices from supplied menu
Filter counts display correctly: Semua (23), Kopi (12), Non-Kopi (11)
No 'Makanan Ringan' filter present - only Semua, Kopi, Non-Kopi as required
Kopi filter shows exactly 12 products with aria-pressed='true'
Non-Kopi filter shows exactly 11 products
Semua filter restores all 23 products
Smart search case-insensitive: 'klepon' finds 'Kopi Susu Klepon'
Smart search case-insensitive: 'latte' finds 'Latte'
Smart search alias: 'cappuccino' finds 'Cappucino' (printed name)
Search by description keyword 'creamy' finds multiple matching products
Combined search + filter works: Kopi filter + 'susu' search = 6 results
Zero-result search displays empty state with helpful message
Reset-all button restores 23 products, clears search, and activates Semua filter
Clear X button appears when search has text and clears input correctly
WhatsApp URLs use wa.me/6281228483649 with exact message 'Halo Kedai Foto Kopi, saya ingin memesan [Nama Produk].'
Google Maps button href is exactly https://maps.app.goo.gl/RSsrnRzFBnMqDMRNA
Maps button opens safely with target='_blank' and rel='noopener noreferrer'
Mobile layout at 390px has no horizontal overflow (body width: 390px)
Mobile menu button visible and clickable at 390px viewport
Mobile menu opens correctly and displays 'Kedai Foto Kopi' brand
Search input visible and usable on mobile
Filter controls visible and usable on mobile
Brand 'Kedai Foto Kopi' appears consistently in navbar, footer, and mobile menu
No 'KopiLokal' brand name found anywhere in page content
Search input has proper aria-label for accessibility
Filter group has role='group' for accessibility
Filter buttons have aria-pressed state that updates correctly
No JavaScript console errors detected
No red-screen errors or error messages on page
Sample products verified: Espresso (Rp 15.000), Latte (Rp 24.000) display correctly
